name: The MOLLER Experiment: An Ultra-Precise Measurement of the Weak Mixing Angle Using Møller Scattering

summary.plain: The MOLLER collaboration's physics case and experimental overview for measuring the weak charge of the electron at Jefferson Lab.
summary.technical: arXiv:1411.4088 (submitted 15 Nov 2014): physics case and experimental overview of MOLLER at the 12 GeV upgraded Jefferson Lab, improving on the SLAC E158 result by a factor of five.
